tool_schemas.name: get-page
tool_schemas.description: Returns the canonical page object for the given page title on the session’s currently selected wiki, including license information and latest-revision metadata, and optionally includes the page content as source wikitext or rendered HTML depending on `content`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `title` is missing/invalid or `content` is not one of `noContent`, `withSource`, or `withHtml`. Raises NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist on the selected wiki, and UNAUTHORIZED if no wiki has been selected for the session.

content.description: Format of the page content to retrieve

tool_schemas.name: get-page-history
tool_schemas.description: Returns a segment of revision metadata for the given page title, ordered newest-first, with up to 20 revisions per segment and pagination links/routes for the next older segment, next newer segment, and the latest segment. You may page by providing `olderThan` (return revisions older than the given revision id) or `newerThan` (return revisions newer than the given revision id), and may optionally filter results by a single `filter` tag. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `title` is missing/invalid, if both `olderThan` and `newerThan` are provided, or if more than one filter is requested; raises NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist and UNAUTHORIZED if no wiki has been selected for the session.

olderThan.description: The ID of the oldest revision to return

newerThan.description: The ID of the newest revision to return

filter.description: Filter that returns only revisions with certain tags. Only support one filter per request.

tool_schemas.name: search-page
tool_schemas.description: Searches the selected wiki for pages matching `query` in titles and content and returns a list of matching pages, limited to `limit` results (default server behavior if omitted) and never more than 100. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query` is missing/empty or if `limit` is outside 1–100. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no wiki has been selected for the session.

limit.description: Maximum number of search results to return (1-100)

tool_schemas.name: set-wiki
tool_schemas.description: Sets the base wiki URL to use for subsequent requests in the current session and returns the resolved/normalized wiki targeting information for that session. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `wikiUrl` is missing or not a valid URI. Raises NOT_FOUND if the URL does not correspond to a reachable/recognized MediaWiki instance for this service.

wikiUrl.description: Any URL from the target wiki (e.g. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Main_Page).

tool_schemas.name: update-page
tool_schemas.description: Appends a new revision to an existing page by replacing the page content with `source`, using `latestId` for optimistic concurrency, and returns the updated page/revision metadata (including the new latest revision). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid, and raises NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist on the selected wiki. Raises CONFLICT if `latestId` does not match the page’s current latest revision id (the page changed since you last read it), and UNAUTHORIZED if no wiki has been selected for the session.

source.description: Page content in the same content model of the existing page

latestId.description: Identifier for the revision used as the base for the new source

tool_schemas.name: get-file
tool_schemas.description: Returns file/media metadata for the given file title, including URLs to download or view the original file and available preview/thumbnail representations. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `title` is missing/invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist on the selected wiki, and UNAUTHORIZED if no wiki has been selected for the session.

tool_schemas.name: create-page
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new page with the provided `title` and `source` in the specified `contentModel` (defaults to "wikitext") and returns the created page object including latest-revision metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid. Raises CONFLICT if a page with the same title already exists, and UNAUTHORIZED if no wiki has been selected for the session.

source.description: Page content in the format specified by the contentModel parameter

contentModel.description: Type of content on the page. Defaults to "wikitext"

tool_schemas.name: get-session
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current wiki session targeting information (resolved base URL and derived API/REST endpoints) and session status. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if no session is present, and NOT_FOUND if the session id is unknown.

sessionId.description: Wiki session id to fetch; if omitted, returns the caller’s current session.

tool_schemas.name: revoke-session
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a wiki session from `active` to `revoked`, preventing it from being used by other endpoints. Returns the updated session. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist, and CONFLICT if the session is not `active`.

tool_schemas.name: expire-session
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a wiki session from `active` to `expired`. Returns the updated session. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist, and CONFLICT if the session is not `active`.

tool_schemas.name: list-pages
tool_schemas.description: Lists pages on the selected wiki with optional filters, returning page metadata ordered by last update time descending by default. Supports cursor pagination. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if no wiki has been selected for the session.

namespace.description: Restrict results to a namespace id (e.g., 0 for main, 6 for File).

status.description: Restrict results to pages in the given lifecycle status.

titlePrefix.description: Return pages whose prefixed title starts with this prefix (case-sensitive per wiki normalization rules).

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return (1-100).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list response.

tool_schemas.name: get-revision
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single revision by id and returns its metadata and, optionally, its source text. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the revision does not exist on the selected wiki, and UNAUTHORIZED if no wiki has been selected for the session.

includeSource.description: When true, includes `source_text` in the response; otherwise returns metadata only.

metadata.name: MediaWiki
metadata.description: This backend stores per-session wiki targeting plus core MediaWiki entities: pages, revisions (edit history), and files/media metadata.
